posts.title: Edoroam
posts.description:
Yes, I know about eduroam — it’s a global education and research Wi-Fi network. In Pakistan, the Higher Education Commission (HEC) has implemented eduroam across many public universities.

It lets students, faculty, and researchers securely access the internet on campus (and even at other eduroam-enabled institutions worldwide) using their university email credentials.

Would you like me to explain how to connect to eduroam or how it works behind the scenes (authentication, RADIUS servers, etc.)?
